public.\u0627\u0644\u0625\u062f\u0627\u0631\u06: Departments and units under the General Directorate of Quarantine

The General Directorate of Quarantine is the official body responsible for protecting the health of citizens and travelers through the implementation of the International Health Regulations (IHR 2005) at all land, air and sea entry points of the Republic of Sudan. The Directorate reports to the Federal Ministry of Health and carries out epidemic surveillance of infectious diseases, health screening of travelers and entrants, issuance of international health certificates, vector control within port areas, and coordination with regional and international health organizations to ensure a rapid response to any public health threat.

public.\u0648\u0639\u0644\u0649 \u062a\u0646\u0: and for implementing the International Health Regulations (IHR 2005) at air, sea, and land entry points,
public.\u0648\u0625\u062f\u0627\u0631\u0629 \u0: and for managing epidemiological surveillance of infectious diseases and coordinating with national and international bodies.
public.\u062a\u062d\u0631\u0635 \u0627\u0644\u0:
The Directorate General of National Quarantine is committed to protecting the health of citizens and travelers and ensuring safe movement across all entry points by applying the highest health standards in line with the International Health Regulations.

Coordination among national bodies is the cornerstone of a successful quarantine system; we continue to raise laboratory efficiency, update reference standards, and qualify personnel.

We call on all travelers to follow the approved health procedures to ensure a safe journey and a stable, healthy environment for everyone.
